text:
maria-sales: GlobalBank asked for an air-gapped onprem POC next month. Key asks: full SBOM, image signing with customer HSM, upgrade cadence commitment, and whether we can provide a signed hotfix channel. Need clarity on delivery size and delivery method (USB vs local registry).

troy-eng: Can do. Notes: initial full bundle ~4.2GB (includes models + runtime). Deltas typically 70-400MB depending on changes. We support chunked delta format for low-bandwidth transfers. Live in-place rolling upgrades in strict airgap require local mirror + staging nodes. Expect ~10 business days for engineering prep if they insist on zero-downtime.

neha-sec: Requirements for HSM integration: offline signing with customer private key *never* leaves their HSM. We need a signing hook and a verification cert bundle that the operator uses during bootstrap. Also: we must deliver an SBOM (CycloneDX) and attestations. They'll want proof of deterministic build process.

owen-ops: Ops checklist: we can supply an operator image that validates signatures during install. We need their chosen transport. USB 32GB is fine for initial bundle; subsequent deltas can be on a small USB or pulled from a local registry mirror they host. For USB workflows, we provide checksum + signature verification steps:

````
# verify downloaded bundle
sha512sum redwood-poc-bundle-2026-06.tar.gz
# compare to provided signature: redwood-bundle.sig
````

Also note: if they want us to create service accounts we require an MSA (managed service account) addendum in the SOW.

lucy-devex: I'll prepare a one-page checklist for the POC operator: pre-install (checklist), install verify (signature + SBOM), post-install smoke tests (model ping, tokenized inference). Will include sample RBAC snippet to create a limited operator account: 

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: redwood-operator
  namespace: redwood-system
---
# Role with minimal perms
```

maria-sales: Pricing question from buyer: is monthly patch cadence included in POC, or extra? They're pushing for monthly security patches.

finance-bot: Standard 30-day POC includes business-hours support and quarterly bundled upgrades. Monthly security patch channel is an add-on at $Xk/month for ops support and prioritized packaging.

troy-eng: Technical risk callout: If they require FIPS-validated crypto for signing/verification flow using their HSM, we need to validate the HSM model and certs. That can add 1-2 weeks for compatibility testing. Document as risk in proposal.

neha-sec: Also require completed security questionnaire + signed NDA before we ship any artifacts. For regulated banks, recommend we include SOC2 scoping language and a clause for audit support in SOW.

owen-ops: Delivery options summary: 1) USB courier (we provide encrypted bundle + signature) 2) Sideload via customer local registry (they host mirror; we upload artifacts to secure staging for transfer) 3) Sneakernet with dedicated manifest. Choose and confirm timeline.

maria-sales: Action list: 1) @troy-eng confirm delta size estimate + zero-downtime lead time 2) @neha-sec confirm questionnaire items to attach 3) @lucy-devex draft operator checklist 4) @finance-bot confirm monthly patch pricing add-on. I'll draft the SOW with three delivery options and a clear risk section.

deploy-bot: Artifact staging scheduled: upload to secure staging-bucket 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z. Notify #eng-runtime when artifacts are ready.

maria-sales: Please drop your one-paragraph deliverable notes into the shared doc by EOD Wed so I can finalize the commercial proposal. :thumbsup:
